defects.detail: 'immensitatis punctum omne ambit spatium' (the point of immensity encompasses all space) -> 'every point of immensity encompasses space'
'Hostii telum' (an opponent's name, cf. Vorstius) -> 'The weapon of the host'

reason: Close rendering of the scholastic replies and thesis VII; misattaches 'omne' in the immensity sentence and turns the name 'Hostii' into 'the host'; otherwise = source.

defects.detail: page opens 'exheredaverit primogenitum ius primogeniturae non stabit' with no subject; translation supplies 'If a father disinherits', completing the previous page's 'an si ...'
'in dicto capitulo cum nimis' -> 'in the said chapter "Although"' (wrong chapter incipit)
'qua opp. sequuntur moderni' -> 'which [the] <note>moderns</note> follow' (word wrongly put in a note; 'opp.' dropped)

reason: Long dense canon-law page rendered literally and nearly completely; supplies 'a father' at the opening, garbles one chapter incipit, and passes some corrupt citation strings through literally (rendered literally, not papered over).

defects.detail: 'Justinianus Imperator, iterum Julianum' -> 'Justinian ... praised Julian' ('iterum' dropped)

reason: Faithful rendering of both paragraphs on jurisconsults, interpretation and practical judgment; only trivial words dropped.
Complete, accurate rendering of the commentary on the apostles' liberation (Acts 5), margins and Greek included; nothing wrong found.

defects.detail: source section number '§. 5.' rendered as '§. 15.' (silent emendation of probable OCR error)

reason: Accurate rendering of §§13-14 on synkatepsephisthe and the title Apostle; silently renumbers '§. 5' to '§. 15'; otherwise = source.

defects.detail: 'Aetherei laeto consurgant vertice montes' (let mountains rise to the ether with joyful peak) -> 'rise up from the joyful ethereal peak'

reason: All couplets of the resurrection poem rendered line for line; one slightly misconstrued line.

defects.detail: marginal citations 'Isid. l. 1. c. 4.', 'Wolfg. Franzius ... Diss. II. §. 119', 'D. Calov. in Com. Gen.', 'B. Luther. in Com. in Gen.', 'Joh. Gerh. Tom. VI ... p. 286.' all absent from the translation
'Tunc coeptum est invocari nomen Jehove' (then the name of Jehovah began to be invoked) -> 'Then it began to be called upon by the name of Jehovah'
'D. CALOVIUM', 'B. LUTHERUM', 'GERHARDUM' expanded to 'ABRAHAM CALOVIUS', 'MARTIN LUTHER', 'JOHANN GERHARD' (first names not in body text)

reason: Body text on Enos and the witnesses is rendered faithfully, but five marginal source citations are dropped and the Gen 4:26 quotation is slightly misconstrued.

defects.detail: 'Postulata ... finiuntur axiomata, in quibus aliquid fieri posse conceditur' (postulates are defined as axioms in which ...) -> 'are finished off by axioms'
'quatenus ex praemissa resultant demonstratione' (from the preceding demonstration) -> 'from a premise of demonstration'

reason: Accurate across §§7-11 on observations, propositions, theorems and problems, but garbles the definition of postulates ('finiuntur' read as 'finished off by').

defects.detail: 'in Sandii Nucleo, ut inscribitur, Historiae Ecclesiasticae, qui rectius putaminum nomine veniret' -> 'Sandius's Ecclesiastical History ... "of husks"' (drops 'Nucleus', the kernel/husk joke)
'a Riveto, Coco' -> 'by Rivet, Cocceius' (Cocus is not Cocceius)

reason: Faithful on the spread of Ebionism and the Apostolic Constitutions; loses the title 'Nucleus' that the pun depends on and misidentifies 'Coco' as Cocceius.

defects.detail: source ends '(quod tamen secus se habet in ser-'; translation completes it as 'in the case of a slave...' from the next page's 'seruo'
'ut lite non contestata advocatio judicis, qua in eodem negotio functus est' -> 'concerning advocacy of the judge not yet having contested the suit' (garbled)
'Digesta de peculio' -> 'Digest on private property'

reason: Section VIII on plaintiff and defendant and its notes rendered fully and accurately; muddles one clause on grounds of suspicion and completes the final broken word from the next page.
Plague-boil remedies with ingredients, weights (lot, quent, ounces) and theriac doctrine all rendered correctly; nothing wrong found.

defects.detail: 'at to praeter, significat terminum & finem rei; praeterquam itur' (the word 'praeter' signifies the end of a thing, beyond which one goes) -> 'But "past" signifies the term and end of a thing, that which is gone by'

reason: Both columns on infinite future duration rendered accurately; the etymological argument on praeter-itum is muddled; otherwise = source.

defects.detail: '夫驂繪之翔回以論巫天之凌蹄涔之遊無以知絳虬之騰' (a small bird's wings cannot speak of heaven-spanning flight; a puddle-swimmer cannot know the crimson dragon's rise) -> 'Without the soaring flight of the dragon carriages to discuss the heavens of the shamans, or the traversing of puddles to understand the rising of the crimson dragons'
OCR '驂繪' and '巫天' rendered as confident 'dragon carriages' and 'heavens of the shamans'
'神焉瘦哉' (OCR for 廋, how can the spirit be hidden) -> 'How lean it is! How lean it is!'

reason: Preface's account of the book's neglect and the commentator's purpose is right, but the closing chain of analogies is garbled into fluent nonsense with its logic lost, and 神焉瘦哉 is rendered 'how lean'.
§§44-53 on kinds, signs and symptoms of hypercatharsis rendered completely and accurately; nothing wrong found.

'intempestivo potu' -> 'intemperate drinking of water' ('of water' not in source)

reason: §§44-53 rendered completely; misplaces 'solum' onto Hippocrates and adds 'of water' to 'potu'; otherwise = source.
Sections on amber juice flowing to the sea (IX end, X, XI) rendered accurately; final catchword 'erodit' is not a criterion; nothing wrong found.
